page_title: OVI 0-0 MAL | Oviedo v Mallorca 05/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Iosu Galech has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
90+7' One of the players from Oviedo times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+6' Today's referee Iosu Galech rightly decides to book Samu Costa (Mallorca) for his harsh tackle.
90+5' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) expresses his disappointment as he receives a straight red card.
90+5' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Iosu Galech produces a RED card from his pocket and Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) heads for an early shower!
90+5' Although Oier Luengo (Real Oviedo) is just on the bench, Iosu Galech has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.

90+5' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
90+5' The attendance is 23333.
90+2' Substitution. Pablo Torre (Mallorca) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Samu Costa walks off.
90+1' We are about to witness a subsitution. Javier Llabres (Mallorca) for Mateo Joseph.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Santiago Colombatto leaves the pitch and Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) comes on.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) receives a red card after his awful challenge. He completely lost his temper and referee Iosu Galech sends him off the pitch.
89' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo)! Let's see what he decides.
89' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo). He’s got to go!

88' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Lucas Bergstrom inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
86' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo).
82' It's time for a substitution. Oviemuno Ejaria (Real Oviedo) comes on in place of Leander Dendoncker.
82' Luis Carrion has decided to make a change. Alex Fores (Real Oviedo) replaces Salomon Rondon.
82' Haissem Hassan pings in a cross towards the edge of the six-yard box. Leander Dendoncker (Real Oviedo) jumps highest but sends his header just over the bar.
80' Substitution. Jan Virgili leaves the pitch and is replaced by Takuma Asano (Mallorca).
78' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
75' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Sergi Darder is replaced by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
74' Mallorca get a corner.
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Oviedo.
73' Oviedo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Oviedo.
73' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Good work from Oviedo as they win a corner.
70' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
68' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Sergi Darder (Mallorca), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
66' Luis Carrion has decided to substitute Ilyas Chaira and he is replaced by Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo).
66' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
64' The ball possession is 61:39.
63' Iosu Galech shows a yellow card to Dani Calvo (Real Oviedo) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
62' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
61' Corner kick. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is ready to send the ball into the box.
59' CHANCE! Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) connects with a cross but he cannot direct his shot on target.
55' It will be a corner kick for Mallorca.
54' Aaron Escandell leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
54' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Mallorca.
53' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Iosu Galech blows for a foul.
50' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
47' Oviedo are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
44' The ball goes out of play. Oviedo are awarded a corner kick.
44' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
43' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Aaron Escandell.
42' A cross from Jan Virgili (Mallorca) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
42' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
39' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and Iosu Galech blows his whistle for a foul.
35' The corner is swung in but Oviedo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
35' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Oviedo earn a corner.
34' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Oviedo comes to nothing.
34' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Oviedo will have an opportunity.
32' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
30' A pass by Sergi Darder (Mallorca) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

28' Mallorca are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
26' 2:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
24' Now Mallorca have a corner.
22' A terrific attempt by Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.
19' The corner from Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) is hurriedly cleared.
19' An attempted cross from Leander Dendoncker (Real Oviedo) is cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Oviedo.
17' A pass from Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is intercepted by Aaron Escandell and the move breaks down.
16' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Aaron Escandell is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
13' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Nacho Vidal, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
11' Oviedo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
10' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) wins himself enough space to meet the resulting corner on the edge of the box and fires the ball at goal, but the keeper does well to stop his effort.
9' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
9' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The linesman points to the corner flag, Oviedo are going to take it.
6' Oviedo are ruled offside.
6' Leander Dendoncker (Real Oviedo) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
5' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

3' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Aaron Escandell!
2' Mallorca keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Iosu Galech is introduced as the referee for today's match.
